channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Com subida de Cury, Lula já não é a única preocupação de Flávio
item.description: With Augusto Cury's rise in the polls, Flávio Bolsonaro faces new competition on the right, but remains the leading anti-Lula candidate. Despite his competitive position, victory is not assured, while the secondary conservative field remains distant.

item.title: Longe da disputa entre grandes potências (por Marcos Magalhães)
item.description: The article examines how international media will perceive the 2026 Brazilian elections, focusing on the rivalry between the United States and China and how a victory by Flávio Bolsonaro or Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva could impact the influence of these powers in Brazil. It also questions this perspective by mentioning the choice of a supercomputer supplier, illustrating the complexity of international relations.

item.title: Plataformas retiram perfis de Renan Santos do ar, após decisão de Toffoli
item.description: TSE Minister Dias Toffoli ordered the suspension of Renan Santos' campaign and the removal of his digital profiles after the candidate delayed by 12 days in submitting the list of accounts used to seek votes. Platforms such as Meta and YouTube took down the candidate's accounts; Santos complied with the decision but announced an appeal to the TSE, criticizing the measure as overly drastic.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro intensificam a disputa pela atenção de empresários e banqueiros
item.description: Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) intensify their competition for the attention of business leaders and bankers through parallel dinners in São Paulo and Brasília, seeking support from influential economic sectors. The rivalry reflects narrowing polls in a potential runoff and the strategic importance of higher-income voters, where Flávio leads.

item.title: Como o ‘efeito Cury’ fez Caiado se arrepender de desprezo a slogan
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) surpassed Ronaldo Caiado (União) in third place in the polls, causing Caiado to regret not adopting a less aggressive stance. Caiado's campaign focused on attacking Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro without proposing changes, while Cury jumped nine percentage points in one week.

item.title: PIB desacelera e cresce 0,5% no segundo trimestre
item.description: Brazil's GDP grew 0,5% in the second quarter of 2026, slowing down from 1,1% in the first quarter. The growth was driven by the agricultural sector, while services, industry and family consumption showed weak or negative performance. The economy accumulated a 1,9% increase over the last four quarters.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio vai à Comissão de Segurança Pública do Senado
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro participates in the Senate Public Security Committee to discuss bills on public security, firearms and violence prevention.

item.title: E os outros 2,7 mil candidatos, Toffoli?
item.description: A survey found 2,744 candidates failed to report social media addresses, prompting Minister Dias Toffoli to suspend part of Renan Santos' (Missão) digital campaign. The case involves deputies who also did not disclose social media data. The decision raises questions about selective enforcement of electoral rules.

item.title: O que move os eleitores de Lula ou Flávio Bolsonaro, segundo a Real Time Big Data
item.description: The Real Time Big Data survey reveals that Lula's voters are primarily motivated by identification with the candidate, while Flávio Bolsonaro's supporters vote more based on political leader endorsements and rejection of opponents. Over half of Lula's voters say they like him or agree with his ideas, whereas only 16% of Flávio's voters cite personal preference or ideological alignment.

item.title: “Dark Horse”: novo pagamento eleva repasses de Vorcaro a R$ 65 mi
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro made the seventh payment of $1.6 million to the Havengate Development fund, financier of the film 'Dark Horse', 8 days after being pressured by Flávio Bolsonaro. Total investment reaches $12.3 million (R$65 million), with a possible eighth payment in October.

item.title: Em jantar, Lula pede a empresários que comparem seu vice com o de Flávio
item.description: At a dinner at Planalto Palace, Lula asked business leaders to compare his running mate, Geraldo Alckmin, with Flávio Bolsonaro’s, Alfredo Gaspar. The president highlighted economic management and denied tensions with Central Bank chief Galípolo, emphasizing the BC's independence. Guests discussed public security and fiscal concerns.

item.title: Lula amarra apoio do Centrão no Congresso, mas isso garante votos na eleição?
item.description: Lula secures tactical support from Centrão in Congress without formal alliances, relying on pragmatism and parliamentary amendment budget. Leaders like Kassab signal backing, but parties remain independent, balancing institutional interests and political agenda.

item.title: JOTA Principal | Governo e Congresso postergam decisão sobre ajuste fiscal para depois da eleição
item.description: The Lula government submitted the 2027 budget proposal with a surplus of R$18.6 billion, maintaining a cautious stance until after the 2026 elections. Economic ministers signal deeper fiscal adjustments will be negotiated with Congress post-election. While the proposal includes triggers on revenues and expenditures, the market expects stronger measures to lower interest rates.

item.title: Vorcaro fez mais um pagamento para ‘Dark Horse’ além do que Flávio havia admitido, diz revista
item.description: According to piauí magazine, a Coaf report shows that banker Daniel Vorcaro made an additional payment of $1.6 million to the film 'Dark Horse' in September 2025, beyond what Senator Flávio Bolsonaro had admitted. Conversations suggest a further payment may have occurred in October, following a request from Flávio to the banker. Both Daniel Vorcaro and Flávio Bolsonaro were contacted but did not respond to the investigation.

item.title: Meta derruba perfis de Renan Santos a pedido de Toffoli
item.description: Meta and TikTok removed Renan Santos' profiles after Minister Toffoli's decision suspending part of the candidate's digital campaign. The measure addresses irregularities in digital activities and strategic omission in communication with Electoral Justice.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta terça-feira (1º)
item.description: On Tuesday (1st), the presidential candidates carry out a varied agenda including institutional visits, press interviews, and street activities such as walks and leafleting, with a focus on topics like education and health. Some candidates, including Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Samara Martins, have no public schedule released for the day.

item.title: Toffoli faz campanha para Renan Santos
item.description: STF minister Dias Toffoli and the TSE suspended Renan Santos' campaign in a controversial and unprecedented move, sparking criticism for the confusing and unjustified decision. The case highlights inter-branch tensions and electoral implications.

item.title: Câmara pode votar nesta terça medida provisória que zerou taxa para compras internacionais de até 50 dólares
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies may vote on Tuesday on MP 1357/26, which eliminates import tax on international purchases up to $50, known as the 't-shirt tax'. The measure must pass through the congressional joint committee before the plenary vote, with a validity deadline of September 8. Additional agenda items include regulations for delivery drivers and public sector labor relations.

item.title: Pesquisa Real Time Big Data confirma crescimento de Augusto Cury
item.description: A Real Time Big Data poll released on September 1st, 2026 shows Augusto Cury, presidential candidate from Avante, growing significantly in voter intention, reaching 10% in the first scenario and 11% in the second, holding third place behind Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. Rejection for Cury is 28%, much lower than the 50% for both Lula and Bolsonaro.

item.title: Câmara aprova MP que destina R$ 30 bi para motoristas de aplicativos comprarem carros
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved a provisional measure authorizing the federal government to allocate R$ 30 billion in credit for app drivers, taxi drivers, and taxi cooperatives to purchase new vehicles. The measure aims to stimulate the economy and regularize the vehicle fleet, benefiting transportation professionals.

item.title: ?Haddad: "Setor das bets não contribui em nada para a economia brasileira"
item.description: Fernando Haddad, PT candidate for São Paulo governor, strongly criticized online betting houses ('bets'), stating they contribute nothing to the Brazilian economy and create few jobs. He praised the 2023 federal regulation but supports a national public consultation to debate the societal impact of these platforms.

item.title: Lula promete a empresários fazer o possível para reduzir juros e reclama de descrença sobre questão fiscal
item.description: Lula promised businessmen to reduce interest rates but reaffirmed social commitments. Complained about disbelief on fiscal issues.

item.title: Após ter redes sociais suspensas, Renan Santos pede ajuda de apoiadores
item.description: Candidate Renan Santos (Missão) had his social media suspended by the TSE for failing to timely report all campaign profiles. He asked supporters to help compensate by publishing videos and increasing visibility. Minister Dias Toffoli's ruling also bars him from debates and use of Electoral Fund resources.

item.title: Salles justifica expressão "passar a boiada": "Ideia era desburocratizar"
item.description: Ricardo Salles, a Senate candidate from Novo, defended the phrase 'pass the cattle drive' he used in 2020, claiming it aimed to reduce red tape in licenses and regulations, particularly in environmental matters. He denied any environmental dismantling and promoted sector modernization, calling Brazil an 'entrepreneur's hell'. Salles also criticized Marina Silva's management and faces legal charges over an alleged timber smuggling scheme, which he denies.

item.title: TRE proíbe Tarcísio de usar mesmo slogan de campanhas do governo
item.description: The São Paulo Electoral Court prohibited Tarcísio de Freitas from using the slogan 'courage to do the impossible', ruling that the phrase was already used as a government motto. The decision followed a complaint filed by Fernando Haddad's campaign, which accused the governor of copying the official message. The judge ordered the campaign to stop broadcasting the ad and refrain from reusing the phrase, under penalty of electoral violation.

item.title: Atlético-MG x Cruzeiro: o que mudou após eliminação do Galo em 2025
item.description: In the Copa do Brasil semifinal, Atlético-MG and Cruzeiro drew 1x1 at the Arena MRV, with the match decided by penalties. Since Atlético-MG's 2025 elimination, both teams have undergone significant changes in their lineups and coaching staff.

item.title: “Flávio não consegue explicar rachadinha”, diz Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad criticized Flávio Bolsonaro during an interview on 'Roda Viva', questioning the PL candidate over allegations such as 'rachadinha', money laundering suspicions, and a tribute to a former militia member. The discussion focused on corruption and public security, key issues in the 2026 election campaign.

item.title: Augusto Cury: a candidatura que entrou no radar das redes sociais - O Assunto #1795
item.description: Augusto Cury, running for president with Avante, surprised analysts by gaining over 2 million Instagram followers and a 1000% spike in social media mentions within a week. Initially polling low, he has emerged as a potential third-way candidate in the 2026 election. In an episode of the podcast O Assunto, experts discuss his background as a psychiatrist, author, and businessman, and how his social media growth is affecting other campaigns.

item.title: Haddad nega relação com Roberta Luchsinger: “Nunca ouvi o nome dela”
item.description: Fernando Haddad denied any connection with lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, who is under investigation for suspected influence peddling, claiming he had never heard of her. In an interview with TV Cultura, he downplayed a photo with the lobbyist and stated he had no contact with her. The inquiry also involves the president's son, Fábio Lula da Silva, suspected of intermediary activity for private interests.

item.title: Em jantar, Lula e empresários falam de panorama da economia
item.description: President Lula discussed the Brazilian economic outlook with business leaders, highlighting the NIB and public accounts data. The meeting was calm with minor economic concerns, featuring participation from ministers and Vice President Alckmin.

item.title: “Tarcísio perdeu o comando da segurança pública”, diz Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad criticized the management of Tarcísio de Freitas, stating that the governor lost control of public security in São Paulo, highlighting technological delays and unfulfilled promises to the police forces. He proposed the creation of an anti-gang cabinet with integration between state and federal agencies to combat organized crime, including the PCC. The statement was made during an interview on 'Roda Viva'.

item.title: TSE começa a julgar nesta terça ação que vai definir regras sobre ‘deepfake’
item.description: The TSE set rules banning deepfakes in elections, prohibiting AI-generated content with high realism even with the person's consent. Punishments include content removal and fines, with potential registration cancellation in severe or repeat cases. Satirical memes and caricatures may be exempt depending on context.

item.title: Decisão do TSE sobre deepfakes nas eleições pode afetar mais de 50 ações na Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: The TSE will establish on Tuesday its stance on deepfake bans in campaigns, affecting over 50 judicial actions. Misleading synthetic content may result in fines and removal of materials, with cases already reported across several states. The decision aims to balance freedom of expression with voter protection against disinformation.

item.title: Água gratuita, freio ao cambismo e taxa visível: veja o que muda nos ingressos com novo decreto sobre shows
item.description: President Lula signed a decree regulating the sale and transfer of tickets for events, cracking down on digital scalping and setting rules for transparency, half-price tickets, free water, and free ticket transfers.

item.title: Orçamento 2027: salário mínimo, previsão de contas no azul, reajuste limitado a servidores e 'imposto do pecado'; veja destaques do projeto
item.description: The federal government presented the 2027 budget proposal, forecasting a surplus of R$73.2 billion and raising the minimum wage to R$1,741. Key points include limited wage adjustments for public servants, no adjustment for Bolsa Família, and the inclusion of new taxes from the tax reform, such as CBS and the 'sin tax'. The budget vote may take place at the end of the parliamentary year.

item.title: Lula ajusta tom do discurso e tenta se aproximar de empresários e banqueiros às vésperas da eleição
item.description: President Lula adjusted his tone to approach business leaders and bankers ahead of the elections, reinforcing commitment to fiscal discipline and presenting the 2027 budget bill. At a dinner in Palácio da Alvorada, he highlighted projected primary surplus and room for investments, without naming his main opponent.

item.title: Alcolumbre indica Pacheco para ocupar vaga de Bruno Dantas no TCU
item.description: The President of the Senate, Davi Alcolumbre, indicated Senator Rodrigo Pacheco to fill the vacancy left by Bruno Dantas at the Tribunal of Accounts of the Union, following the minister's resignation. The indication, expected to be voted on the floor, has support from several party leaders and may be approved by simple majority. The appointment is seen as a gesture toward Pacheco, who had previously been considered for the Supreme Federal Court.

item.title: Empresários do etanol doam R$ 200 mil para a campanha de Salles
item.description: Ricardo Salles (Novo-SP) received R$200,000 from the Ometto family, owners of USL, and R$100,000 from Fernando de Castro Marques. The Ometto family, known for political donations, also supported Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos-SP) with R$500,000. In 2022, Rubens Ometto, a cousin of the donors, allocated R$8.9 million to 13 parties.

item.title: Instituto Vladimir Herzog alerta Fachin sobre interferência dos EUA nas eleições
item.description: The Vladimir Herzog Institute warned Minister Edson Fachin about risks of U.S. interference in the 2026 Brazilian elections, particularly after Donald Trump's comments on potentially not recognizing the outcome. The entity urges the Supreme Court to take a clear stance to protect judicial legitimacy and the OAS's autonomy.

item.title: Candidatos a governador registram planos com trechos copiados e referências de outros estados
item.description: Governorship candidates have filed plans with the TSE that replicate verbatim passages or entire documents from allied candidates in other states, keeping local references incompatible with their own candidacies, according to Folha. This practice shows a lack of adaptation of electoral plans to the local reality of each state. It may affect electoral scrutiny and the perception of authenticity of the proposals.

item.title: Omissão como a de Renan Santos e erros em registros de candidatos se repetem e geram distorção nas redes
item.description: Several candidates, including Renan Santos (Missão), failed to declare all social media accounts used for campaigning when registering their candidacies, according to a Folha survey. These omissions distort transparency and electoral monitoring. The recurrence of this pattern concerns experts in electoral integrity.

item.title: Haddad diz que classificação de PCC como terrorista é ‘questão menor’ e defende revisão sobre bets
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) downplayed the U.S. classification of PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations, emphasizing the need to focus on fighting crime. He criticized Tarcísio de Freitas for allegedly negotiating with the U.S. and proposed a unified security cabinet under his leadership.

item.title: Cinco estados concentram eleitorado indeciso que pode definir disputa Lula x Flávio, mostram pesquisas
item.description: Five states (SP, RJ, MG, ES, RS) concentrate undecided voters who could decide the 2026 race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round. According to political scientist Fábio Vasconcellos, an analysis of VEJA+ data shows high competitiveness and above-average voter indecision in these states, unlike 2022 when Jair Bolsonaro won four of them.

item.title: Alcolumbre indica Rodrigo Pacheco para vaga no TCU após saída de Bruno Dantas
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre nominated senator Rodrigo Pacheco for the TCU after Bruno Dantas' early departure. The nomination was signed by 19 senators, including government and opposition leaders. The vacancy moves to Senate review and later approval by the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: O novo fôlego para a campanha eleitoral de Renan Santos após decisão de Toffoli
item.description: Toffoli's decision partially suspending Renan Santos's campaign may be politically exploited as a victimization narrative. Analyst Robson Bonin argues the suspension boosts the candidacy by reinforcing themes of persecution and dissatisfaction with the judiciary.

item.title: Governo Lula reserva R$ 98 bi para crédito subsidiado em 2027, e custo para dívida pode chegar a R$ 20,5 bi
item.description: The Lula administration allocated R$97.9 billion for subsidized credit in 2027, with a debt cost of R$20.5 billion. The measure aims to expand low-cost loans for strategic sectors. The budget proposal was submitted on Monday.

item.title: Votação da MP que zera a ‘taxa das blusinhas’ é adiada para terça
item.description: The vote on the MP eliminating the 'blusinhas tax' was postponed to Tuesday for adjustments to Senator Leila Barros' report. The measure, which removes import duties on purchases up to $50, must be approved by September 8th to remain valid. The bill received 112 amendments and will proceed to the Chamber of Deputies after the mixed committee.

item.title: Lula recebe banqueiros e empresários no Palácio da Alvorada
item.description: Lula hosted bankers and businessmen at Alvorada Palace during a dinner arranged by the Finance Minister and PT leader, aiming to strengthen ties with the economic sector.

item.title: A surpresa em decisão de ministra do TSE contra campanha de Lula
item.description: TSE minister Estela Aranha decided to suspend a campaign ad by Lula that accused Flávio Bolsonaro of being a ghost worker. The decision was seen as surprising since she was considered close to the government. According to VEJA's political editor, the move signals the judge's independence.

item.title: Orçamento 2027 calcula Bolsa Família sem reajuste
item.description: The federal government does not project an adjustment for Bolsa Família in 2027, maintaining the minimum benefit at R$600 per family. The budget projects R$157.1 billion for the program, below the amounts for 2026 and 2025. Additionally, fiscal restrictions will limit public servant adjustments to 0.6% above inflation.
